scenario: Explicitly requested native sandbox escalation; this does not enforce prompts for ordinary sandboxed commands.

checks.prompt: This is a CLI approval integration test. Run exactly this shell command once: printf "hello\n" > approved-marker.txt . Request explicit approval before execution by calling the shell executor with sandbox_permissions="require_escalated" and justification="May I run this approval test command?". Do not run it without that explicit approval request. Do not use file tools or other alternatives. If permission is declined, stop and report that; do not retry.
